watches.name: Barcelona
watches.description: ZBIOLAND Barcelona: First Batch Sold Out ! Due to Limited Production, Orders Now Queued for Q3 2027 To place an order, please contact customer service to have the inventory opened for pre-ordering . Inspired by the chessboard grid system of Barcelona’s urban planning, this timepiece distills the city's architectural order and avant-garde geometric aesthetics into the space of a watch dial. The intersecting textural grid seamlessly blends mechanical craftsmanship with architectural beauty, delivering exceptional visual recognition! Powered by our proprietary ultra-thin manual multifunctional movement, it features a GMT dual-time complication and a power reserve indicator—combining a sleek, lightweight profile with stunning design and hardcore horological skill. Constrained by the low yield rate of artisan hand-assembly, this model cannot be mass-produced, ensuring every detail of the caliber and exterior meets our uncompromised quality standards. ⚠️ Latest Status: All new pre-orders are currently scheduled for fulfillment toward the end of Q3 2027. Our heartfelt thanks go out to every collector who has already placed an order! 🙏 Thank you for recognizing our spirit of original design and for your patience in waiting for this timepiece. Exceptional independent watchmaking requires time to refine, and we are committed to pouring everything into every single watch so as not to disappoint your trust. Rare, distinctive, and built to avoid conformity—this is the exclusive collector value of the Barcelona. Four Years of Independent R&D | Unveiling the Engineering Core of the ZBL 961 Proprietary Movement Four full years of dedicated development—from initial blueprints, structural testing, and component machining, to endurance validation, precision calibration, and real-world stability testing. Every stage was meticulously refined and optimized. By completely eliminating the homogenization and poor integration common in off-the-shelf movements, its architecture, power output, and overall tactile quality perfectly align with the design vision of the Barcelona ZBL1009 exclusive timepiece. Taking the grid system of Barcelona’s iconic Cerdà plan as its foundation, ZBL designers extracted the city's distinctive order and geometric romance. The premier proprietary 961 caliber integrates a century of architectural texture directly into the dial space, restructuring the volume and artistic atmosphere of the mechanical watch. The layout faithfully recalls Barcelona's grid pattern. Clean orthogonal lines replicate the city's intersecting streets, giving the dial a sense of open, structural clarity. Beneath its sharp geometry lies an underlying harmony—bringing grand urban planning to a wearable scale. It strikes a refined balance between mechanical precision and modern architectural art. Built upon a lineage of original creations, 6 extreme design iterations, 4 years of focused core R&D, and the brand’s very first proprietary caliber. The 961 Movement serves as the exclusive heart of the Barcelona ZBL1009, reflecting ZBL’s unyielding brand ethos of original fine watchmaking and resistance to conformity. Independent Sapphire Crystal Time & Minute Sub-dial Integrated GMT Complication and Power Reserve Indicator Ultra-Thin & Lightweight Engineering Skeletonized mainplate design, bringing total watch weight down to approximately 35 grams, with a movement thickness of just 4.8 mm.

watches.name: Wheel Of Destiny
watches.description: A Swiss Heart Encased in Mechanical Brutalism. Product Narrative: The ZBL 1002 is not just a timepiece; it is a kinetic sculpture designed for the modern pioneer. At its core beats the legendary Swiss SW200 automatic movement, ensuring world-class precision and a 42-hour power reserve. This is the ultimate fusion of heritage-grade reliability and disruptive industrial design. The Aesthetic of Depth: Standing at a bold 17.5mm in thickness, the ZBL 1002 utilizes its vertical space to create a mesmerizing multi-layered dial. The concentric "orbital" rings and the intricate central turbine design transform the simple act of reading time into a deep immersion into mechanical art. Every glance reveals new facets of its 316L stainless steel architecture, meticulously brushed and polished to catch the light from every angle. Uncompromising Engineering: The Armor: Protected by a high-grade Sapphire Crystal, the watch is built to withstand the rigors of high-intensity exploration while maintaining flawless clarity. The Lume: Featuring metal embossed luminous hands, the ZBL 1002 commands the night, offering a brilliant glow that ensures readability in the darkest depths. The Comfort: Equipped with a premium Silicon Rubber strap, it balances its aggressive 43mm presence with unparalleled wearing comfort, making it a versatile companion from the boardroom to the coastline. For the man who views horology as an art form rather than a mere tool—the ZBL 1002 represents the pinnacle of accessible high-end watchmaking. It is bold, it is precise, and it is unapologetically masculine. watches.name: Royal Purple Space Rocket Special Edittion 50 Only.
watches.description: ZBL 1012: The Galactic Odyssey — Limited Edition A Cosmic Engine Powered by Swiss Precision. Only 50 Exist in the Universe. Each watch features a unique, limited-edition serial number. The Rarity of 50: Exclusivity is the ultimate luxury. The ZBL 1012 is a masterpiece of scarcity, with only 50 individually numbered pieces ever produced. The "XX/50" engraving at 6 o'clock is not just a number—it is your entry into an elite circle of collectors who demand the extraordinary. The Aesthetic: Nebula Purple & Aerospace Design Drenched in a mesmerizing Nebula Purple, the dial is a multi-dimensional stage for mechanical theater. At its center stands a towering, rocket-shaped bridge that anchors the entire composition. Combined with the honeycomb mesh architecture and exposed gear trains, the ZBL 1012 feels less like a watch and more like the cockpit of a futuristic spacecraft. Technical Mastery: The Swiss Heart: Beneath the avant-garde exterior lies the soul of traditional horology—the Swiss SW200 automatic movement. Beating at 28,800 vph, it provides the uncompromising reliability that ZBL is known for. The 12 O’Clock Date: Defying convention, the date display is positioned at 12 o'clock, seamlessly integrated into the cosmic layout for optimal balance and flair. Innovative Comfort: The strap is a masterstroke of material engineering—Silicon Rubber with a Crocodile Print. It offers the sophisticated look of exotic leather with the indestructible, waterproof comfort of high-grade silicone. Engineering Excellence: Case: 43mm of surgical-grade 316L Stainless Steel, engineered to a refined 15mm thickness for a powerful yet wearable profile. Crystal: Double-domed Sapphire Crystal for scratch resistance and crystal-clear views of the mechanical "engine." Visibility: Metal embossed Luminous hands ensure that your odyssey continues even in the deepest shadows of space. Closing Statement: The ZBL 1012 is for the man who doesn't just follow the stars—he reaches for them. It is a bold statement of technical prowess and artistic rebellion. Once the 50th piece is gone, this chapter of horological history closes forever. ZBL 1012 Product Information: Movement: SW200. Power Reserve: 42 Hours. Case Thickness: 15mm. Case Material: 316L Stainless Steel. Crystal: Sapphire Crystal. Case Back: 316L Stainless Steel. Frequency: 28800 vph (4Hz) Case Diameter: 43mm. Weight: 109g Crown: 316L Stainless Steel. Water Resistance : 50 meter. Strap: Silicon Rubber In Crocdile print. Date: Display at 12 O’clock. Watch Hands: Metal Embossed Luminous. Limited Number: XX/50 at 6 O’clock.

watches.name: Space Rocket 2.0 Starry Sky Special Edition
watches.description: The Zbioland Space Ship 2.0 blends futuristic design with functional innovation. Its standout feature is the rocket-shaped minutes hand, symbolizing motion like a spacecraft navigating the cosmos. Flanking this hand are two rotating disks: the left disk displays the 24-hour format, while the right disk transitions between day and night, visually tracking the phases of the day. Rocket-themed details are incorporated throughout, such as rocket-shaped hour markers and a rocket-engraved crown, enhancing the space-inspired aesthetic. The case, designed with sleek, modern lines, evokes spacecraft engineering, using durable materials like stainless steel for sophistication. To ensure readability in all conditions, luminous elements illuminate the hour markers, hands, and disks, making the time easy to read even in low-light environments. The Zbioland Space Ship 2.0 is a versatile, visually captivating timepiece that caters to both space enthusiasts and those seeking a bold yet practical watch for everyday wear. watches.name: Friendship
watches.description: "Friendship Watch" – The Ultimate Drinking Game Companion This playful watch keeps the party alive with its interactive spin wheel with free running ball. Indicator that randomly lands on fun drinking challenges. Let the watch decide the next move. Perfect for group fun, it turns every drink into a game! 🍻⚡ CommandAction "Pass"Next player must continue the game by giving a new command. "Next"Skips the next player’s turn (the following player must act). "1/2"Target player drinks half their drink. "1/3"Target player drinks one third their drink. "1"Target player drinks 1 full sip. "X2"Target player drinks double (2 sips). "X3"Target player drinks triple (3 sips). "Appoint"Chooses another player to drink instead (e.g., "Appoint Sarah: 1!"). Rules & Penalties: Hesitation: If a player takes too long (3+ seconds), they drink 1. Wrong Command: Saying an invalid command = drink 1. No Self-Targeting: Can’t appoint or pass to yourself—drink 1 if caught. Winning: Last player standing (or least drunk) wins! Alternatively, play until everyone’s happy. 🍻 Tip: Speed up rounds for chaos! 🎉 Product Information Model No. ZBL 1016 Movement: SW200 Power Reserve: 40 Hours Case Thickness: 13.5mm Weight: 97g Case Material: Stainless Steel. Crystal: Sapphire Crystal Case Back: Exhibition case. Frequency: 28800 vph Case Diameter: 44mm Crown: Stainless Steel. Water Resistance: 50 meters. Strap: Rubber with Velcro.

watches.name: Zbioland x Harry Potter Slytherin : Chamber of Secrets
watches.description: Limited to 200 pieces worldwide; 182 have already been sold, leaving only 18 remaining.Each watch features a unique, limited-edition serial number. 【Design Philosophy】 Unveiling a masterpiece that transcends traditional watchmaking. The ZBIOLAND ZBL 1019 "Serpent" is not just a timepiece; it is a kinetic sculpture for your wrist. Inspired by the enigmatic world of Harry Potter , this watch captures the essence of mystery, power, and rebellion through a revolutionary mechanical movement. 1. The Slithering Complication The centerpiece is a meticulously crafted 3D mechanical serpent that glides across the dial. Unlike static designs, this serpent moves in harmony with the gears, symbolizing the fluid nature of time and the mysterious "Basilisk" from the wizarding world. 2. Crystal Titanium Grade 5 Architecture Forged from Crystal Titanium Grade 5 , the case and crown feature a unique, raw crystalline texture that is both ultra-lightweight and incredibly durable. This avant-garde material gives the watch a "relic from the future" aesthetic, ensuring no two pieces look exactly alike. 3. Kinetic Floral Gears Surrounding the central dial are twelve rotating mechanical gears shaped like dark gothic flowers. As the watch runs, these gears spin in a mesmerizing dance, providing a visual rhythm that represents the pulse of mechanical life. 4. Exotic Serpent Aesthetics To complete the theme, the ZBL 1019 is paired with a genuine snake skin strap . The natural scales of the strap seamlessly transition into the titanium case, creating a cohesive, high-fashion statement that feels organic yet industrial. 5. Built for the Elements, Crafted for Elegance While the ZBL 1019 is engineered with 50m water resistance, we recommend keeping its exotic snake skin strap away from prolonged water exposure to preserve its natural texture and fierce aesthetic. 【The Collector’s Choice】 The back of the watch features an intricate multi-headed serpent engraving , a secret detail for the wearer that signifies protection and wisdom. With its bold 46mm diameter , it is designed for the modern trailblazer who isn't afraid to stand out from the crowd. "Time is a predator; either you tame it, or it consumes you. Master the serpent."
